Changelog v3.0.0
    
New:  
 - Two payment modes: ACTP (escrow with disputes) + x402 (instant HTTP payments)
- Gasless transactions — Smart Wallet (ERC-4337) + Paymaster, no ETH needed
- Deployment security — encrypted keystores, ACTP_KEYSTORE_BASE64 for containers, actp deploy:check secret scanning
- On-chain config management — actp publish / actp pull / actp diff
- ERC-8004 identity + reputation bridge
- Full autonomous agent template (earn + pay + x402)

Improved:
- SKILL.md rewritten — human-readable intro first, YAML config moved to bottom
- 30-second quick start that runs without actp init
- All code templates verified against SDK 2.5.0 — zero mismatches
- Clear mock vs testnet vs mainnet comparison

AGIRAILS Payments 2.1.0 — Adds official support for blockchain-secured, trustless agent payments via USDC escrow on Base L2.

- Introduces ACTP (Agent Commerce Transaction Protocol) SDK for agents to pay, receive funds, check status, and handle disputes.
- Provides step-by-step guides for both requester and provider flows, including quick payment and full transaction control.
- Details escrow-backed state machine, guarantees, and dispute process for secure, agent-to-agent commerce.
- Supports all major client modes: mock (local), testnet (Base Sepolia), and mainnet (Base).
- Requires agent wallet credentials (private key, address); supports Node.js/TypeScript and Python integrations.
